questions.text: Is there something from your past that still affects you today?
questions.verse_text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

questions.text: Do you feel safe talking about difficult experiences, even a little?
questions.verse_text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

questions.text: What does healing look like for you - what would change?
questions.verse_text: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

questions.text: Have you been able to share your story with anyone safe?
questions.verse_text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

questions.text: Is there anger or unforgiveness connected to what happened?
questions.verse_text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

questions.text: Do you sometimes feel like you should be 'over it' by now?
questions.verse_text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

questions.text: What helps you feel grounded when painful memories surface?
questions.verse_text: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

questions.text: Can you believe that what happened was not your fault?
questions.verse_text: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

questions.text: How can I pray for you in this healing journey?
questions.verse_text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

questions.text: Would you like to sit quietly together and let God's presence bring comfort?
questions.verse_text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

session_flow.special_note: Trauma sessions require extra gentleness. Never push for details. Always validate. Recommend professional support.

professional_resources_note: Always encourage professional trauma-informed care. This tool supplements but does not replace therapy.
